_readme: Display names changed at the artist's own request.
fxhash usernames were registered on chain, in the FXHASH User Registry
(KT1Ezht4PDKZri7aVppVGT4Jkw39sesaFnww), and this archive is a record of what
that catalog held. So a name is not edited on a whim: an entry here means the
artist asked, through the maintainer, to be shown differently.
`was` is the on-chain name, kept so nothing is lost by the change. It is still
the name in public/data/users.json, which is a reading of the registry and is
left exactly as the chain has it — nothing the site displays comes from there.
Run `npm run artists:names` after editing this file, and again after any rebuild
of collaborations.json, which re-derives collaborator names from users.json.
